subject.title: Skill and Read tools truncating output at ~600-700 chars in 2026.6.11

question: Should this issue stay as a separate live-reproduction target, or should maintainers fold the tool-output portion into the existing model-visible tool-result threads after preserving the Skill Workshop detail?
rationale: The source evidence contradicts the reported short cap, while live related issues cover adjacent output-loss symptoms; maintainer judgment is needed before choosing a canonical thread or requesting reporter artifacts.

options.title: Keep Separate For Repro
options.body: Keep this issue open until a v2026.6.11/current-main reproduction captures raw transcript JSONL, model-submitted payload, channel/UI projection, config, and Skill Workshop proposal id/workspace state.

options.title: Fold Tool Output Into Canonical Thread
options.body: Treat the output-loss portion as partial overlap with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99241 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99586, while leaving a separate note for the Skill Workshop persistence symptom.

options.title: Sponsor Immediate Investigation
options.body: Assign an owner to reproduce the reporter's exact stable Linux/systemd setup before deciding whether this is a new fix path or duplicate evidence.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate For Repro
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a v2026.6.11/current-main reproduction captures raw transcript JSONL, model-submitted payload, channel/UI projection, config, and Skill Workshop proposal id/workspace state.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the most recent nearby tool-result and web_fetch history, which is the broadest reported surface if the cutoff is in model-visible output projection.
